analysis:
Examined the add-on hold drain owner in ProviderLoop+PlannedDisconnect.swift (head 6-23, 36-41, 64-87, 100, 116-129) and the startup gate changes in ProviderLoop+Serve.swift (head 24-26, 74-78, and the refusing→refusingForServiceChange checks at head 81/93/135/204/227/235).

Changed behavior: an add-on hold now refuses inference, but startup still proceeds to local endpoint start, preload and coordinator registration. Only a service-change drain (stop/update/other) aborts startup. startAddonHoldService() runs before applySecurityHardening, the local endpoint and the startup preload, so a persisted hold closes admission first.

waitForSafeDisconnect refuses to send the drain barrier while the hold owns the drain, except for a planned reconnect (underAddonHold: true), whose fresh registration replaces the fenced connection. performPlannedReconnect continues under .reconnect or .addonHold ownership. finishPlannedReconnect calls reassertAddonHoldAfterReconnect(). resumeAfterAddonHold keeps admission closed via a .reconnect drain when a reconnect is pending or a barrier may have been committed.

No security regression identified. Attestation, registration attestation, key custody (A-003), T-053 connection invalidation (clearConnectionAuthorization on connected/disconnected) and T-008 encryption are unchanged. Effects are confined to admission/availability; a hold fails toward refusal.

Unverified contracts for integration (implementations not supplied):
- servingDrain.refusingForServiceChange must be true for lifecycle/update/modelSwitch/reconnect owners so shutdown-before-registration still triggers (T-010/T-029 availability).
- servingDrain.refusing must remain true under .addonHold, so handleInferenceRequest and the local endpoint refuse work while registered.
- startAddonHoldService/stopAddonHoldService, reassertAddonHoldAfterReconnect and resumeAddonHold semantics need review.
- The persisted hold-file location and permissions are operator-controlled (TB-003). This is acceptable only if the hold can merely refuse work, never grant it.
- The order in finishPlannedReconnect at head 98-100 (setAccepting before reassert) may briefly open the local tracker if resumeReconnect clears an addonHold owner; this needs confirmation.
